recent_news.headline: Why Seattle Restaurant Owners Neglect Critical Grease Trap Maintenance
recent_news.summary: Seattle health inspectors enforce grease trap violations strictly, with fines ranging from $500 to $5,000 depending on severity. Repeated violations escalate penalties dramatically and can result in temporary closure orders.

recent_news.headline: June 2026 Fire Report: Waste and Recycling Industry Is Operating in a Permanently Elevated Fire-Risk Environment
recent_news.summary: Ryan Fogelman's monthly fire incident report documenting elevated fire risk across North American waste and recycling operations in May 2026, with 40 incidents recorded—six above the historical monthly average.

recent_news.headline: City of Phoenix WATER SERVICES DEPARTMENT (Grease, Roots, Manholes)
recent_news.source: City of Phoenix Water Services Department
recent_news.summary: Phoenix water services document addressing sewer cleaning and FOG/grease problems. The document identifies coagulated grease and cooking oil as the biggest problem causing sewer overflows and backups in the city's infrastructure.

backfill_news.headline: This Week in Waste: Top Stories June 1 – June 4
backfill_news.summary: Waste360's weekly industry roundup featuring two major acquisitions: TerraCycle's acquisition of Connecticut-based NLR Inc. and Hiab's $1.035 billion acquisition of Canadian refuse collection vehicle manufacturer Labrie Environmental Group.
